questions.prompt: When the soldiers had pitched camp near Thebes, they feared an ambush in the narrow pass.
questions.answer: Cum mīlitēs castra prope Thēbās posuissent, īnsidiās in angustiīs timēbant.

questions.prompt: The ancestors, whom we praise, defended the city walls with great courage.
questions.answer: Majōrēs, quōs laudāmus, moenia urbis magnā virtūte dēfendērunt.

questions.prompt: After the wedding the riches of the family were divided among the children.
questions.answer: Post nūptiās dīvitiae familiae inter līberōs dīvīsae sunt.

questions.prompt: In the darkness the enemy prepared their weapons and set an ambush.
questions.answer: In tenebrīs hostēs arma parāvērunt et īnsidiās collocāvērunt.

questions.prompt: It is right to spare the conquered, but wrong to betray a friend.
questions.answer: Fās est victīs parcere, sed nefās amīcum prōdere.

questions.prompt: Of her own accord the queen offered help to the exiles at dawn.
questions.answer: Suā sponte rēgīna māne exsulibus opem obtulit.

questions.prompt: Nothing is sweeter than freedom, as our elders used to say.
questions.answer: Nihil lībertāte dulcius est, ut majōrēs nostrī dīcere solēbant.

questions.prompt: The tower stood like a mountain against the raging storm.
questions.answer: Turris īnstar montis adversus saevientem tempestātem stābat.

questions.prompt: The craftsman melted the copper and the silver to make a statue.
questions.answer: Faber aes et argentum liquefēcit ut statuam faceret.

questions.prompt: Milk and gold were offered to the gods before the battle.
questions.answer: Lac et aurum deīs ante proelium oblāta sunt.

questions.prompt: The bronzes displayed in the temple were admired by all the citizens.
questions.answer: Aera in templō exposita ab omnibus cīvibus laudābantur.

questions.prompt: Such cases of ignorance among the young alarmed the wise old man.
questions.answer: Tālēs ignōrantiae inter juvenēs sapientem senem terrēbant.

questions.prompt: On the Kalends of March the consul announced a truce to the enemy.
questions.answer: Kalendīs Mārtiīs cōnsul indūtiās hostibus nūntiāvit.

questions.prompt: During the Megalesian festival the citizens hurried to Athens.
questions.answer: Per Megalēsia cīvēs Athēnās contendērunt.

questions.prompt: Before the Ides the general led his forces to Pompeii.
questions.answer: Ante Īdūs dux cōpiās suās Pompejōs dūxit.

questions.prompt: At Leuctra the Thebans overcame the Spartans in a fierce battle.
questions.answer: Apud Leuctra Thēbānī Lacedaemoniōs ācrī proeliō vīcērunt.

questions.prompt: The ambushes hidden in the woods terrified the marching soldiers.
questions.answer: Īnsidiae in silvīs occultae mīlitēs iter facientēs terruērunt.

questions.prompt: The household gods were carried out through the doors of the burning house.
questions.answer: Penātēs per forēs ārdentis domūs ēlātī sunt.

questions.prompt: After the funeral rites the ancestors' ashes were placed in the tomb.
questions.answer: Post exsequiās majōrum cinerēs in sepulcrō positī sunt.

questions.prompt: The narrow passes were guarded by armed men throughout the whole night.
questions.answer: Angustiae ab armātīs virīs per tōtam noctem custōdiēbantur.

questions.prompt: Men like the Catos are rare in these corrupt times.
questions.answer: Catōnēs hīs corruptīs temporibus rārī sunt.

questions.prompt: It is not lawful to violate the truce which the elders swore.
questions.answer: Nefās est indūtiās violāre quās majōrēs jūrāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The riches gained by ambush brought disgrace upon the whole family.
questions.answer: Dīvitiae īnsidiīs partae tōtī familiae dēdecus attulērunt.

questions.prompt: By her own choice the maiden entered the temple at dawn on the Ides.
questions.answer: Suā sponte virgō Īdibus māne templum intrāvit.
